toolCalls.input:
{
  "sql": "SELECT t.name AS team_name, COUNT(g.id) AS goals_scored
FROM api.world_cup.goals g
JOIN api.world_cup.matches m ON g.match_id = m.id
JOIN api.world_cup.teams t ON g.scoring_team_id = t.id
JOIN api.world_cup.tournaments tor ON m.tournament_id = tor.id
WHERE tor.year = 2022 AND m.stage = 'Knockout'
GROUP BY t.name
ORDER BY goals_scored DESC;",
  "datasourceId": "23ebd2e8-5087-4398-aee9-4866cb76a81b",
  "limit": 100,
  "rationale": "This query counts the number of goals scored by each team during the knockout stage of the 2022 World Cup. This data is essential for creating a chart to visualize team performance."
}
